run_cluster_status: run the script with --account flag to display SLURM GPU CPU and memory usage per user
run_get_qos_for_account: run get_qos_for_account to fetch available QOS values for a given SLURM account name
run_extract_tres_usage: run extract_tres_usage to parse a TRES string and return CPU GPU and memory values
review_get_qos_for_account: review get_qos_for_account which queries sacctmgr to extract pipe-separated QOS values for an account
refactor_extract_tres_usage: refactor extract_tres_usage to support additional TRES resource types beyond CPU GPU and memory
